src:
!set -m
sleep 30 &
sleep 40 &
jobs
echo "last background PID: $!"
kill %1; sleep 0.2; jobs
nohup bash -c 'echo started; sleep 1; echo finished' > long.log 2>&1 &
wait
cat long.log
kill %2 2>/dev/null; wait 2>/dev/null; jobs; echo 'no jobs left'
